bullets: Financial板块（包括MUFG -3.7%、GS -2.8%、ZION -1.4%）整体承压下跌，而策略重仓的Real Estate板块（FR +4.5%）逆势上涨，两个板块的相反走势直接拉开了+0.84%的超额收益。（[Sector Update: Financial Sto…](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sector-financial-stocks-softer-afternoon-195507210.html)、[Sector Update: Financial Sto…](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sector-financial-stocks-decline-friday-173117432.html)）

Financial stocks在周五午盘后持续走弱导致大盘下跌0.99%，但这种风险厌恶环境下投资者转向防守性更强的Real Estate等板块寻求避险，使得持仓中的FR等地产股获得相对收益。（[Sector Update: Financial Sto…](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sector-financial-stocks-softer-afternoon-195507210.html)、[Sector Update: Financial Sto…](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sector-financial-stocks-decline-friday-173117432.html)）

策略净值-0.14%跑赢SPY -0.99%的核心原因是持仓结构的板块错配优势：Financial Services和Banking相关标的（MUFG、GS等）跌幅超过3%拖累大盘，而Real Estate标的FR的+4.5%涨幅与BTSG的+3.7%涨幅共同抵消了下跌标的的负面影响。（[Sector Update: Financial Sto…](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sector-financial-stocks-softer-afternoon-195507210.html)、[Sector Update: Financial Sto…](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sector-financial-stocks-decline-friday-173117432.html)）

尽管策略在Financial板块的敞口导致净值绝对值下跌，但Real Estate板块的意外强势与Healthcare板块（BTSG）的同步上涨，共为策略贡献了超过800元的正向收益，最终形成了相对SPY的超额收益表现。（[Sector Update: Financial Sto…](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sector-financial-stocks-softer-afternoon-195507210.html)、[Sector Update: Financial Sto…](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sector-financial-stocks-decline-friday-173117432.html)）
